Both companies’ fiscal years are standard calendar years, so Alphabet’s FY2022 and FY2024 are directly comparable to Meta’s FY2022 and FY2024. The margin figures below are computed directly from GAAP revenue and operating income totals in their respective 10-Ks, so the basis of comparison is consistent. [DOC]

From the filings:  
- Alphabet FY2022: revenue $282,836M, operating income $74,842M. [DOC]  
- Alphabet FY2024: revenue $350,018M, operating income $112,390M. [DOC]  
- Meta FY2022: revenue $116,609M, operating income $28,944M. [DOC]  
- Meta FY2024: revenue $164,501M, operating income $69,380M. [DOC]

Compute operating margins (operating income ÷ revenue):

- Alphabet 2022: 74,842 / 282,836 ≈ 26.46%. [DOC]  
- Alphabet 2024: 112,390 / 350,018 ≈ 32.11%. [DOC]  
  → Expansion ≈ 32.11% − 26.46% = 5.65 percentage points. [DOC]

- Meta 2022: 28,944 / 116,609 ≈ 24.82%. [DOC]  
- Meta 2024: 69,380 / 164,501 ≈ 42.18%. [DOC]  
  → Expansion ≈ 42.18% − 24.82% = 17.35 percentage points. [DOC]

Difference in expansion:  
17.35 pp (Meta) − 5.65 pp (Alphabet) ≈ 11.71 percentage points. [DOC]

ANSWER: Meta expanded its operating margin more, by about 11.7 percentage points more than Alphabet.
